description: This Java class models a database relationship (relation) within the OFBiz Entity framework. It captures relation attributes such as type, related entity name, foreign key, key mappings, and provides methods for creating, accessing, and serializing relation data.

classes.name: ModelRelation
classes.description: This class models a <relation> element in the OFBiz entity model, representing relationships between entities, with properties like relation type, related entity, foreign key, key mappings, and related methods.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create a ModelRelation instance with specified parameters.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create a ModelRelation from a <relation> XML element.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create a ModelRelation from database reference info.

methods.name: getCombinedName
methods.description: Returns a combined string of relation title and related entity name.

methods.name: getRelEntityName
methods.description: Returns the name of the related entity.

methods.name: getFkName
methods.description: Returns the foreign key name used in the relation.

methods.name: getKeyMaps
methods.description: Returns the list of key mappings defining the join conditions.

methods.name: isAutoRelation
methods.description: Indicates if this relation was automatically generated.

methods.name: findKeyMap
methods.description: Finds a key map by its field name.

methods.name: findKeyMapByRelated
methods.description: Finds a key map by its related field name.

methods.name: toXmlElement
methods.description: Serializes this relation into an XML DOM element.
